findings.body: An Excel formula without a cached result is reduced to `null` by `formulaResult`, and this line then converts that missing value to zero for Debit and Credit. Such a workbook can therefore import with fabricated zero amounts instead of being blocked with a request for a recalculated, saved source, directly violating the required cached-formula behavior. The added tests contain no formula cells, so this path is also untested.
findings.title: Not done: The new workbook import preserves and reconciles the source while existing chat and reporting features keep their previous be

findings.body: `cellSourceValue` trims every string before both parsing and construction of `sourceRow`. Consequently, identifiers, comments, and arbitrary retained columns containing leading or trailing whitespace are not preserved as supplied; even the purported original-row evidence contains the modified value. Keep a raw source representation for evidence and normalize only the separately parsed fields. The preservation test uses strings without surrounding whitespace and does not detect this loss.
findings.title: Source-row evidence strips significant source text

findings.body: The permitted path list does not include `.factory/stories/FINANCIAL-AGENT-DEMO/tasks/ACTUAL-PARSER.json`, yet the branch adds this task-state record. It is not used by the parser or its tests and even records the branch as still `working`; remove it from this scoped change.
